name: rcore_app
description: Next.js compose template for the Sticks website (RokctAI/sticks-web, app_type sticks): the sdks[] it composes. No backend: the site only explains Sticks and links the app's downloads, and nobody signs in on it.
_comment: Sticks is ROKCT's own product, an app-only service: people use it in the Sticks app (RokctAI/sticks, Dart), and the Next.js site is the landing shell only (Ray, 2026-10-11). There is no new sticks SDK (Ray, 2026-10-11: the AI lives in agent_sdk), so agent_sdk is home, through its app_type.sticks block. That block sets "common": false, so this shell takes none of agent_sdk's top level (rokct.ai's chat, register flow and opportunities, which need db/, auth and a backend): only the Sticks landing. No auth_sdk: the site has nothing to sign in to (the brief: 'There is no website to sign up on'), so the header draws no Log in or Sign up. No corporate_sdk: no company pages. Merge order: The-Rokct-Protocol (this template and the common:false installer) and agent_sdk 1.24.0 first, then the sticks-web compose PR.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of telemetry/nextjs/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Mandatory in every Next.js composition (SDK_ECOSYSTEM.md hard invariant 9, mirroring the flutter templates' telemetry_sdk entries). Empty-manifest seam owner: installs nothing; base_sdk's kernel carries the TelemetryClient.

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of base/nextjs/install.py at core@573d570 (git blob 7020b16a, 1074 bytes); required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: The base SDK's nextjs half (core#160): the platform kernel — app/services/base (platform gateway, tenant hosts, session, telemetry), the base admin content/settings/system actions and pages, the manager shell, the shared app sidebar, nav-user/team-switcher, date-range-picker and use-mobile. Composed here because telemetry_sdk 'requires' app/services/base/platform-gateway.ts, which only this half installs: without it the supacharge-web composed build cannot resolve @/app/services/base/platform-gateway. Its own 'requires' names host-owned files (lib/utils.ts, the components/ui primitives, components/custom/branding.tsx, app/config/*, app/lib/*) plus merchants_sdk's shop action and merchant-nav and auth_sdk's app/lib/session.ts — warn-only via check_requires(), not an auto-install; the telephony shell provides the host-owned half.

sdks.name: agent_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of agent/nextjs/install.py at agent@68ed5d75 (the generic installer with sdk_name 'agent_sdk'; the same digest the consumers index pins); required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Home SDK through app_type.sticks (agent_sdk >= 1.24.0): app/page.tsx draws the Sticks landing Ray approved (the concept artifact PDm9514Z16ypx8dk3oQQtq), its site metadata registers at base_sdk's site-metadata marker, and "common": false (Protocol installer >= this template's PR) keeps agent_sdk's rokct.ai top level out of the shell.
